# Cleanup through nested observing branches

The first projects prepare two independent plus states and measure each in the
Z basis. A third Bit starts in the plus state. The checked
and direct forms apply the same Z phase once per true measurement result. The
final X readout therefore equals the exclusive OR of the two results. The
returned bit order is final readout, inner condition, outer condition.

In the third project, the inner true branch of the outer true branch omits its
phase. Only the history where both conditions are true changes, and every
history has weight 1/4. The JSON records preserve the first runtime observations.
They are small numerical checks separate from the Lean observing semantics.
